(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

PreludeSys is seeking a .NET Developer to join its Development team and help build next-generation applications. The role focuses on developing n-tier, web, and desktop applications in a professional environment.
Experienced .NET Developer contributing to development of next-generation software applications

Responsibilities:
• We are searching for experienced software engineers to join our Development team to help build our next generation applications

Requirements:
• experienced software engineers
• a proven track record of developing n-tier, web and desktop applications in a fast paced, dynamic professional environment
• 1 to 2 years off professional, hands on experience developing software utilizing C#, ASP.Net (MVC), SQL Server, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and other web technologies
• Experienced with end-to-end development of software for web applications from client design/development through to web services, server side business logic, to optimal database design, development, storage and access
